content.user_title: Audit Agent Instructions for Accuracy and Clarity
content.value_statement: Stale commands, broken paths, and vague rules make agent instructions unreliable. This skill combines local heuristic checks with evidence-based review and proposes shorter instructions before approved edits.
actual_capabilities: Guides discovery of AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules, and Copilot instruction files.
Checks backtick-delimited file references against repository and instruction-file paths.
Compares common package-manager commands, Makefile targets, and justfile recipes with locally available definitions.
Flags long files, duplicate lines, vague phrases, unfilled placeholders, and possible secrets.
Guides manual review of contradictions, redundant rules, and opportunities for path-scoped instructions.
Produces an evidence-based audit and proposed revision, then waits for approval before editing.
limitations: Checks are heuristic and cannot prove that instructions are correct or complete.
The bundled checker requires Python 3.8 or later; manual review is the documented fallback.
Command parsing covers selected package-manager, make, and just syntax; command safety and contradictions require manual judgment.
Secret signatures are incomplete, and file references outside recognized patterns may be missed.

use_cases.title: Refresh Repository Instructions
use_cases.description: Find stale commands and missing paths after repository changes, then propose corrections with supporting evidence.

use_cases.title: Reconcile Agent Rules
use_cases.description: Compare instruction files for conflicting requirements and identify rules better suited to specific paths.

use_cases.title: Review Instructions Before Sharing
use_cases.description: Check for possible secrets, leftover placeholders, and unclear rules without repeating sensitive values in the report.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Instruction File
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit AGENTS.md for broken paths, vague wording, placeholders, and possible secrets. Report findings without editing files or running project commands.

prompt_templates.title: Check Command References
prompt_templates.prompt: Review CLAUDE.md command references against repository definitions. Identify missing scripts and targets, and mark commands you cannot safely verify.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Instruction Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Find repository agent instruction files. Compare their rules for contradictions, duplicates, and scope problems, citing file names and line numbers.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Shorter Revision
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit all discovered instruction files. Propose shorter versions that preserve hard constraints and incident-based rules. Wait for approval before editing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: consolidate evidence into proposed changes

output_examples.input: Audit an instruction file containing a missing script reference and an obsolete directory.
output: Must fix: The documented script has no matching definition in the repository manifest.
Must fix: The referenced directory does not exist at the documented location.
Not verified: Deployment was not run because it can change external state.
Proposed version: Remove obsolete references and retain verified instructions, pending owner approval.

output_examples.input: Review a long instruction file with repeated rules and a possible secret.
output: Must fix: A possible secret was detected. Its value is omitted; remove it and rotate it if real.
Should trim: A repeated rule duplicates an earlier instruction.
Should trim: Replace vague quality language with a testable requirement.
Proposed version: Keep unique hard constraints and move relevant rules into scoped files.

best_practices: Run the checker from the intended repository root and supply the instruction files explicitly.
Inspect project command definitions and use a trusted environment before running verification commands.
Require evidence for corrections, redact possible secrets, and approve proposed edits before applying them.
anti_patterns: Treating a clean heuristic report as proof that every instruction is correct.
Running deployment, migration, or deletion commands merely to verify documentation.
Removing incident-based rules or hard constraints solely to reduce file length.

faq.question: Which instruction formats can I review?
faq.answer: The workflow covers AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Claude rule files, Cursor rules, and GitHub Copilot instruction files.

faq.question: Does the checker execute commands from instruction files?
faq.answer: No. It compares command references with local definitions. The separate review workflow permits safe verification commands and excludes deployment, migration, and deletion.

faq.question: Does the skill edit files automatically?
faq.answer: The workflow requires an audit report and proposed revision, then waits for approval before editing.

faq.question: What does the Python checker require?
faq.answer: It uses Python 3.8 or later and only standard-library modules. The instructions provide manual checking as a fallback.

faq.question: Can it guarantee that no secrets remain?
faq.answer: No. It detects selected secret patterns. Review flagged values privately, omit them from reports, and rotate credentials when exposure is real.

faq.question: How are contradictions and unclear rules handled?
faq.answer: The assistant reviews these manually, cites conflicting instructions, and proposes clearer wording. The script does not resolve semantic contradictions.
